changelog:
Initial release – scan R&D records to detect potentially protectable innovation signals.

- Identifies technical contributions suitable for patent or trade-secret review from diverse R&D documents.
- Guides users through intake, extraction, classification, and triage of innovation signals.
- Separates screening from legal opinions; does not make final eligibility or claim determinations.
- Supports structured evidence capture and recommends next review steps tailored to context and jurisdiction.
- Integrates dynamic use of supporting references throughout all workflow stages.
summary: Identify potentially protectable technical contributions in R&D updates, meeting notes, design documents, architecture descriptions, experiment records, and technical-improvement narratives. Use when a user asks what may be innovative, patent-review worthy, suitable for trade-secret review, or in need of invention-disclosure follow-up.
